You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-workers-crypto-6|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built on a foundation of open-source tools and decentralized payment processing, ensuring that you retain full control over your digital storefront. With GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can deploy a fully functional online store without relying on restrictive platforms. This approach also future-proofs your business against potential platform outages or policy changes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. First, ensure you have a clear understanding of the digital products you want to sell, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software. Next, set up a crypto wallet to receive payments, and consider the cryptocurrencies you want to support. You'll also need to configure your hosting and backend logic to work seamlessly with your chosen payment processor.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With NOWPayments, you can easily integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification into your storefront, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% fee. By leveraging Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of digital products, ensuring instant and secure access for your customers. This streamlined pipeline eliminates the need for intermediaries, allowing you to maintain full ownership and control over your sales process.
Take control of your digital sales with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. With your crypto wallet and payment processor in place, you can begin selling your digital products to customers worldwide. As payments are received, your automated delivery pipeline will ensure timely and secure product distribution, providing a seamless experience for both you and your customers. This is where the true power of sovereign commerce infrastructure shines, empowering you to take control of your digital sales and forge a path to success.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital storefront gains traction, it's essential to have a plan in place for scaling your infrastructure. This involves monitoring your sales and customer engagement, identifying potential bottlenecks, and optimizing your hosting and backend logic to ensure seamless performance under increased traffic. By leveraging the flexibility and customizability of your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can easily adapt to changing demands and continue to grow your business without being held back by restrictive platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your payment and delivery pipelines with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators looking to establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. By investing in this kit, you'll gain the tools and knowledge necessary to deploy a fully functional online store, complete with automated payment and delivery pipelines.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these concrete steps: set up your hosting and backend logic, configure your payment processor and crypto wallet, automate your digital product delivery, test and optimize your storefront, and launch your online store. With these steps, you'll be well on your way to establishing a thriving digital sales platform that's truly under your control.
